scope: Corollary 1.3 (Universal hyperreflexivity) of the manuscript “Kadison's similarity theorem through uniform derivation estimates” (preprints/Kadisons-similarity-theorem-through-uniform-derivation-estimates-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 288 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 6c1ce1a87b049839), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF pages 2-3. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. The quote crosses a page break and includes whatever the extraction places there, such as a page number. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let H be any complex Hilbert space and let M ⊂ B(H) be a unital von Neumann algebra. For T ∈ B(H), set αM(T) = sup{∥(1 − e)Te∥ : e ∈ M′ , e = e∗ = e2 }. 2 Then, with the absolute constant C from Theorem 1.2, dist(T, M) ≤ 2C αM(T) (T ∈ B(H)). (2) Thus every such M is hyperreflexive with constant at most 2C, independently of the algebra, its represen- tation, and the Hilbert space. No optimality of this constant is asserted.
